summary: Completed testing of Patient Priority Score feature (0-100). All backend API tests pass (13/13). Frontend integration verified - score badges with numbers, colors (green/yellow/red), labels (Engajado/Atenção/Risco alto) and alerts are correctly displayed in the PatientsList page.

issues: Score badges are only visible on XL screens (hidden xl:flex). Consider showing a compact version on smaller screens.

passed_tests: GET single patient score returns correct structure (patient_id, score, status, label, level, factors, alerts)
Status matches score range (green for 80-100, yellow for 50-79, red for 0-49)
Factors have correct structure (score, max, detail) for all 6 components
Alerts is a list with correct structure (type, severity, message)
Batch scores returns correct structure with patient_id keys
Empty batch request returns empty object {}
Single patient in batch works correctly
Total score equals sum of factors
Factor weights match expected values (checklist=40, login=20, feedback=10, peso=10, fotos=10, protocolos=10)
Frontend: Score badges displayed with data-testid='patient-score-{id}'
Frontend: Score number visible in colored circle
Frontend: Alerts shown below score badge when present

routes/patient_scoring.py: Batch limit of 100 patients is appropriate
